The '''Reena system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] located in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Reena Province]], on the [[Caloria Run/Legends|Caloria Run]]. It was an endpoint of the [[Procopian Shipping Lane]].
